name: Paris

French.commander: King Joseph, with Marshals Marmont and Mortier

summary: The allied armies attacked the heights of Belleville, Romainville and Montmartre, held by Marmont and Mortier with conscripts, National Guards and the pupils of the École Polytechnique; that night Marmont signed the capitulation, and the allies entered the city next day.

toCome.name: Marmont's Wing
toCome.formation: Arrighi's, Ricard's and Lagrange's divisions, Compans's, Ledru des Essarts's and Boyer de Rébeval's provisional divisions, and Bordesoulle's, Merlin's and Chastel's cavalry
toCome.summary: Held the heights of Romainville and Belleville on the right; Arrighi's division held Bagnolet and Montreuil.

toCome.name: Mortier's Wing
toCome.formation: Michel's Guard depots, Charpentier's and Curial's Young Guard and Christiani's Old Guard divisions, with Ornano's and Roussel d'Hurbal's cavalry
toCome.summary: Held the plain on the left, from Pantin and Aubervilliers to La Villette and La Chapelle.

toCome.name: Moncey's National Guard
toCome.summary: About twelve thousand men, under Marshal Moncey.

toCome.name: The Russian Guard and Reserve
toCome.summary: Yermolov's Guard came up late; the Russians took Bagnolet and Charonne.

toCome.name: Langeron's and Vorontsov's Corps
toCome.summary: Came on by Le Bourget on Blücher's wing.

toCome.name: Yorck's and Kleist's Corps
toCome.formation: I and II Corps, Army of Silesia
toCome.summary: Took La Villette, Kleist's corps storming La Chapelle.

toCome.name: The Prussian Guard
toCome.summary: Thrown back at Pantin, then took the French guns there.

toCome.name: The Crown Prince of Württemberg's Corps
toCome.formation: IV Corps, with the Austrian grenadiers
toCome.summary: Took the bridges of Saint-Maur and Charenton, and Saint-Mandé.

toCome.name: Gyulai's Corps
toCome.summary: Sent against the forest of Vincennes.
